resources.name: Willing Hearts Meal Assistance
resources.costNote: Free meal assistance for approved beneficiaries
resources.summary: A soup kitchen preparing free meals for distribution across Singapore, with shelter and other support programs.
resources.availabilityNote: Meal-assistance applications require a social worker or social-service agency. The kitchen is not presented as a public meal walk-in.
resources.sourceDetail: The official services page explains meal-assistance referral, distributed meals, shelter, and support services.

resources.costNote: Free to search; provider rules vary
resources.name: Singapore ComCare and Social Service Offices
resources.summary: Singapore's official pathway to ComCare financial and social assistance through local Social Service Offices and complementary community schemes.
resources.availabilityNote: Eligibility depends on residency, household circumstances, and program assessment. Use the official page to identify the correct office.
resources.sourceDetail: The official page explains that ComCare assistance is available through Social Service Offices and links local support schemes.
resources.coverageNote: Nationwide office network; marker represents Singapore.
